title: Exploring Wild Arizona: Dust Storms, Fort Bowie & Mountain Trails
credit: "Exploring Wild Arizona: Dust Storms, Fort Bowie & Mountain Trails" by Campfires & Motors (youtube.com/watch?v=crksH675oRQ), licensed CC BY
desc:
Join us for another wild week of full-time RV living as we explore the scenic and rugged beauty of the Wilcox, Arizona area! Our adventure begins at Chiricahua National Monument, where we hike the Sugarloaf Mountain Trail and take in stunning panoramic views. Along the way, we try a local desert treat—prickly pear cactus candy. Then we get caught in a dust storm warning that shakes things up.
